ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PROCEXP152.sys File Created In TMP
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the creation of the PROCEXP152.sys file in the application-data local temporary folder.
This driver is used by Sysinternals Process Explorer but also by KDU (https://github.com/hfiref0x/KDU) or Ghost-In-The-Logs (https://github.com/bats3c/Ghost-In-The-Logs), which uses KDU.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("PROCEXP152\\\.sys$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\procexp64\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\procexp\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\procmon64\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\procmon\\\.exe.*")))
